_comment: Cross-brand App Atlas — per-brand metadata. Edit when an app rebrands or moves package ID. Used by scripts/app_atlas/build_atlas.py and the .github/workflows/app-atlas-builder.yml workflow. package_id is the sole source identifier: Google Play is the only version and APK source, so a brand needs nothing else to be pollable.

porsche._comment: PCNA build (North America). The rest-of-world build ships as a separate package — see the porsche_row entry below.

porsche_row._comment: Rest-of-world My Porsche. EU users run this package, not com.porsche.one — so a PCNA-only reading was never the version our EU reporters are on. At 20.26.37 (versionCode 188460) both builds are the same code apart from package-name strings and one Porsche-Card availability path, but that is a per-version finding, not a standing guarantee: tracking both is what makes a future split visible instead of silent.

search_patterns._comment: Strings we grep for in extracted APK content. Discoveries from Phase A.2+ get appended to the per-brand atlas markdown.
search_patterns._auth_secrets_comment: Phase A.5 (v2.5.5) — mine auth-config secrets that drift with VW backend rotations. The 2026-05-28 Azure WAF migration would have been caught proactively if these patterns had been in place. Added in response to #313 / evcc PR #30277+#30292 / volkswagencarnet #331.
